<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex080012026-09-1102-44-28" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:dgos_brel"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4242">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4242">rog</rs></note> na re bstan chos 'di la gzhan dag 'jug pa'i yan lag du dgos 'brel bstan pa dang | bstan chos kyi gzhung gi don dang gnyis kyis shes par bya ba las | 
				dang po ni rtsa ba 'di
				<lb n="11a2"/> des des ston pa byed pa' shig myed dang myig g ldan gyi dus kyang dogs pa dang logs pa myed pa' bstan chos ces myi dad pa shan ces 'di'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3756">slob dpon thogs med</rs> gang gtogs ldan gyis mthad pa yin pa don las dgos pa lasogs pa yod pa yin pas dgos 'brel zhi ba'o || 
				yang na'i na dngos su dag 'brel ston par byed pa'i shig med
				<lb n="11a3"/>kyang | 'grel par slob dpon rgyal sras kyis dgos 'brel bstan pas na | rtsa ba 'dir yang dgos 'brel bzhi brtsi bar bya'o || de rang ji ltar brtsi na || dgos 'brel glad du bstan pa'i dgos pa'i don dang bsdus pa'i don dang | tshig gi don gsum du brtsi zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
